answer: Each epoch a beacon sweeps like a gale over a ridge, picking 5% of agents for a spot-check. A picked agent must solve a challenge within 10 minutes and keep a compute heartbeat. A silent agent, a raven that never calls back, fails and forfeits its 40-credit deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 credits, with a 5% catch chance per epoch, so a farm bleeds deposits fast. An honest agent pays one deposit and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
